Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::makeNewOrder(orderid: Integer): Boolean {
	precondition:
		let matchingOrder: Set(OrderProduct) = OrderProduct.allInstance()->select(o|o.Id = orderid) in
		matchingOrder.isEmpty()
	postcondition:
		let newOrder: OrderProduct in
		newOrder.oclIsNew() and
		newOrder.Id = orderid and
		newOrder.OrderStatus = OrderStatus::NEW and
		newOrder.Time = 'now' and
		OrderProduct.allInstance()->includes(newOrder) and
		result = true
}
